findings.decompiled: idx = 41 / s = caller / while idx > 1: if idx >= 42: revert with Panic(50) / mem[idx + 160 len 1] = byte(s % 16, 0x3031...) / idx = idx - 1 / s = s / 16
findings.source: Strings.sol:64 for (uint256 i = 2 * length + 1; i > 1; --i) { buffer[i] = _SYMBOLS[value & 0xf]; value >>= 4; }
findings.issue: The loop reads well, but each copy keeps the bounds check of buffer[i] although i starts at 2 * length + 1 = 41 (or 65), only decreases, and stays above 1, so 'idx >= 42' can never hold (46 dead Panic(50) branches).
findings.rule: An induction variable initialised to c and only decremented while it is > 1 lies in [2, c] inside the body; a test against a bound above c is false and its branch dead.
